description: Design a complete photobooth (a 'booth') for this operator from a description — the Studio designs the welcome screen for phone and laptop, the in-booth background, the colour theme, the capture mode, a title and a link name, exactly as dreambooth.app/new does. Before calling, gather in chat what /new would ask and put ALL of it in the prompt: the occasion or business, the vibe or style, colours, and the language the booth should speak — there is no separate questions step. It returns a job id immediately; call check_generation, and do NOT describe the booth as designed or created until that says done. The result is a DRAFT with a draftId: nothing is in the operator's booth list until create_booth. Every call makes a new draft and spends 1 of its 3 full generations, and an account may start 10 drafts an hour — never call it speculatively or twice for one request; change a draft with refine_booth instead.

language.description: The language the booth's own text should be in, as a code: 'id', 'en', 'es'. Defaults to English — ask if the operator's booth is not in English.

prompt.description: The booth, from what the operator said and what you gathered, up to 1000 characters. Start with what the operator said, in their words and language, then add the brief. Never swap a choice they made for one you prefer; fill only what they left open. Write facts and art direction, not marketing copy. Include: the occasion or business, with names, ages, dates and places exactly as given; one visual reference in words — theirs if they gave one, otherwise one you pick from the occasion and name to them (e.g. '1970s Indonesian film poster', 'hand-painted warung sign', 'Swiss minimalist poster'); do not ask them for one; 2-3 colours; 2-4 concrete objects or motifs (e.g. 'enamel tin mugs', 'pressed jasmine'). Do not write the headline or taglines — the Studio writes the copy — unless the operator gave exact wording; then quote it and say it must appear as written. No emoji, no praise words ('stunning', 'elegant', 'magical', 'vibrant', 'intricate', 'high quality', '4k', 'unforgettable'), no sparkles, glitter, bokeh, lens flare, glow, glossy 3D unless asked. Do not name brands, characters or franchises; the image model refuses them.

name: start_booth
title: Design a new booth
